data.one_liner: Unified API for detecting the current platform and basic system info across Flutter, web, and desktop.
data.what_it_does: Wraps dart:io and dart:html Platform APIs into a single interface. Offers getters like isWeb, isAndroid, isDesktop and basic properties such as numberOfProcessors and operatingSystemVersion.
use_when: You need simple platform checks to branch code for web, mobile, or desktop.
You want a single import to access common Platform properties on all supported targets.
avoid_when: You require detailed device information beyond basic OS detection.
You need advanced features like hardware sensors or permissions.
strengths: Single unified API for all Flutter targets
Covers all major platforms (android, iOS, web, windows, macOS, linux)
weaknesses: Only provides basic platform info, no deep device details
Duplicates functionality already available in dart:io/dart:html
Limited to the features listed in the README

alternatives.name: universal_platform
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers similar cross‑platform detection with a lightweight implementation.
